date_evidence: Earliest day-verified methodological primary source: arXiv math/0410169 submitted 2004-10-06; earlier 1990 Poisson theorem is cited but its exact first-public calendar day was not verified.
integrity: The claim is a mathematical analysis of finite synchronous Boolean network dynamics with all-size proof and finite corroboration. Generic period and Stein–Chen approximation theorems are explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: Not a full attractor census or finite individual-basin calculation. The result is derived using known Poisson approximation machinery. Full text of some older domination papers and indexed result packages was not accessible. Independent validation and full historical priority determination have not been performed.
title: Poisson attractor selection and a sharp density window for NOR dynamics on Boolean cubes
